findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 58 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the splenic vein, suggesting invasion. The tumor is also in contact with the left renal vein, which shows stenosis, indicating invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in two nodes each at stations 8a and 11p. Multiple nodular shadows are observed in both lungs, raising suspicion of multiple lung metastases.
